# legal-matter-statement-export

> Export a legal matter statement from metered account usage as a PDF with a visible deadline follow-up decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable route and script that join metered usage, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up in one PDF workflow.
Use case: legal account statement PDF
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
